recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future desire for richer terminology examples should be handled as a new BRR terminology/example request, not as remaining work for FHIR-31855.
issue_request: FHIR-31855 was a Published/Persuasive BRR issue for FHIR-core ClinicalUseIssue asking for a clearer diseaseStatus definition and examples because the original wording was unclear. Jira comments identified examples such as chronic and metastatic and later recorded that those words plus example value sets had been added.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git commit d99459f74a7b955aff3fd87bae9662f127aa2c49, which added the chronic/metastatic example wording to both ClinicalUseDefinition.indication.diseaseStatus and ClinicalUseDefinition.contraindication.diseaseStatus. The current artifact path differs from the original Jira label because FHIR-31847 renamed ClinicalUseIssue to ClinicalUseDefinition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ClinicalUseDefinition as an active resource and leaves the old ClinicalUseIssue normative line commented out. The current StructureDefinition still binds both diseaseStatus elements to ValueSet/disease-status, and the ClinicalUseDefinition examples list includes an indication example with populated diseaseStatus content. Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion or minutes.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative source already implements the accepted clarification.
